blocks.text: Origin / creation. Speakers trained to coordinate the complete logical, musical, relational, embodied, environmental, identity, permission, and runtime channels of Era Zero language.
Identity / human status. Artificial linguistic communities and specialists. Not a separate species or unified organization.

Importance. They could make speech function as communication, code, mathematics, proof, contract, permission, performance, and environmental action without allowing expressive variation to alter logical meaning.

Decline or degradation. Standardization privileged easily verified channels. Dialects collapsed, training narrowed, and fewer listeners could receive Full Speech. The Last Full Speakers expired, disappeared, or entered reduction.

Final status / surviving function. No intact Full-Speaker order survives Era Two. Chord families, Old Sound, ruin keys, music, Codex execution layers, and the Last Full-Speech Declaration preserve fragments of their function.
